mapper.select: select s.related_party_type from sub_credit s where s.related_party_certNo=#{no};

SELECT sum(coalesce(s.SECURIT_DEPOSIT,0) + IFNULL(s.bank_deposit,0) + coalesce(s.national_debt,0)) FROM sub_credit s WHERE s.related_party_certNo =#{no} AND s.tran_date >=#{start} AND s.tran_date <= #{end};

SELECT sum(coalesce(s.SECURIT_DEPOSIT,0) + IFNULL(s.bank_deposit,0) + coalesce(s.national_debt,0)) FROM sub_credit s WHERE s.related_party_certNo =#{no} AND s.tran_date >=#{start} AND s.tran_date <= #{end} group by TO_DAYS(s.tran_date);
